parts.name: arm strip 0

physics.Basic_description: A long, tapered brown wooden strip forming the upper fixed jaw of the tongs.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the stationary gripping surface against which the moving arm presses.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the mid-section of the strip with a parallel jaw gripper to stabilize the object.
physics.reason: Wooden tool arms are typically solid slats of wood for structural rigidity.

parts.name: spring clip

physics.Basic_description: A small silver metallic cap or clip located at the very tip of the handle end.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as a stopper or reinforcement for the spring mechanism at the pivot end.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and peripheral to be a primary grasp target; avoid grasping here.
physics.reason: Small metal hardware components like clips or caps are effectively solid for mass estimation at this scale.

parts.name: arm strip 1

physics.Basic_description: A long, tapered brown wooden strip forming the lower movable jaw of the tongs.
physics.Functional_description: Flexes or pivots to close against the fixed arm, creating the gripping action.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the mid-section opposite the fixed arm to manipulate the tong's opening.
physics.reason: Wooden tool arms are typically solid slats of wood for structural rigidity.

parts.description: A long, tapered brown wooden strip forming the lower movable jaw of the tongs.
parts.function: Flexes or pivots to close against the fixed arm, creating the gripping action.

parts.name: ring band

physics.Basic_description: A rectangular wooden loop encircling both arms near the handle end.
physics.Functional_description: Slides along the arms to lock them closed or release them to open.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the ring firmly to slide it along the arms, controlling the grip state.
physics.reason: The ring is a loop structure enclosing empty space for the arms to pass through, making it a thin-walled hollow shape.

parts.description: A rectangular wooden loop encircling both arms near the handle end.
parts.function: Slides along the arms to lock them closed or release them to open.

parts.name: grip 0

physics.Basic_description: Small wooden protrusions or facets on the slide ring providing texture.
physics.Functional_description: Increases friction for the user's fingers to slide the locking ring easily.
physics.Grasped_description: These features aid the gripper in securing a hold on the slide ring without slipping.
physics.reason: These are small solid protrusions carved from or attached to the ring, effectively solid wood.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
